open_file_with_pathmanager: open a file using PathManager.open with a given path and mode for reading or writing
copy_file_with_pathmanager: copy a file from source to destination using PathManager.copy with an optional overwrite flag
check_path_exists: check if a path exists using PathManager.exists and return a boolean result
list_directory_contents: list the contents of a directory using PathManager.ls and return a list of entries
create_directories_with_pathmanager: create directories recursively using PathManager.mkdirs with an exist_ok policy
